execution_method: uv run --group notebook jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute
dependency_source: pyproject.toml notebook dependency group and uv.lock
output_policy: The successfully executed output is retained and copied to the submission notebook; both files have identical SHA-256 digests.
checks: Checked-in synthetic CSV matched generated typed records and exact generated bytes.
Train/holdout split reconstruction, model artifact, and metric summary reproduced exactly.
Runtime model loaded the checked-in artifact and exposed explicit OOD/abstention states.
claim_boundary: All data and labels are synthetic; this is software evidence, not real-facility predictive validation.
